summary: 11 features and 1 fix across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • orleans: add dynamic endpoint allocation with port probing (833375e)
  • frontend: add brand logo upload and management (5f3f4e3)
  • orleans: add dynamic endpoint allocation with port probing (834fc1a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • debug: add DLC disable switch component (f61f548)
  • i18n: update locale entries for chat and concurrency (075702c)
  • conversation: add hero model label display to conversation panel (d70aa80)
  • statusbar: add debug disabled DLC guidance indicator (1a9c539)
  • concurrency: add debug DLC override utilities (8e1a65c)
  • git: add repository search and filtering (b031ce3)
  • settings: add brand customization with turbo-engine DLC support (afbabfe)
  • kanban: add Git Management quick action to dropdown (ab787de)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • hermes: improve error message extraction from nested failure payloads (a20e74b)
